master.note: Leader line. Same fix as follower 1.2.11 in the shared receive path: the control UART (3 Mbaud, one interrupt per byte) stopped receiving for good after a single overrun, because the error callback never restarted reception -- the stream kept flowing while every command went unanswered. Reception is now restarted, and GET_UART_STATS reports rx_errors / rx_rearms. Verified on 0115m and 0116m (upgraded from 1.2.2): 15 min each of a 100 Hz encoder+IMU stream with a 100 Hz acknowledged command, ~87,000 commands, zero failures. AFTER FLASHING, unplug and replug the leader's USB cable.

slave.note: RS00 followers are handed: the gear train is mirror-mounted, so the open direction follows the side in the firmware SN (last digit odd = left = Reverse 1, even = right = Reverse 0) instead of one default per model. Auto-calibration uses that direction and corrects a stored one that disagrees (that run approaches slowly, since the old zero is at the open end); a model-record change picks the side's direction too. EL05 and units whose SN gives no side behave as 1.2.14. Verified on 0089s (left) and 0094s (right); 0089s deliberately stored reversed was corrected on the next 24 V power cycle. Carries 1.2.14 (motor firmware version record, protocol V2.8). AFTER FLASHING, unplug the 24 V power cable for ~2 s and plug it back; the USB cable can stay in.
